run_versiongenerate: run versiongenerate.py with input_dir and output_dir to extract version from configure.ac and write Version.h
run_extract_version: run the script to parse AC_INIT in configure.ac and extract major, minor, and fix version numbers
run_generate_version_header: run the script to generate a Version.h header file with GTEST_VERSIONINFO_SHORT and GTEST_VERSIONINFO_LONG defines
review_version_expression: review the regex version_expression that matches AC_INIT macros with bracketed three-part version strings
refactor_versiongenerate: refactor versiongenerate.py to use argparse instead of sys.argv for cleaner CLI argument handling
